model: EfficientNetB3 (ImageNet weights, frozen) + GlobalAveragePooling2D + Dropout(0.5) + Dense(1, sigmoid)
dataset: Breast Cancer image dataset (binary: cancer / non-cancer)
source: Breast_Cancer_Prediction.ipynb, cell 36 (sklearn classification_report on the validation split)
notes: roc_auc was never recorded during training. Run `python evaluate.py --cancer-dir <dir> --non-cancer-dir <dir>` on a labelled test set to compute precision/recall/F1 and ROC-AUC and refresh this file. Recall on the cancer class (0.68) is the weakest number and the most clinically important: roughly 1 in 3 cancers in the validation split were missed at the 0.5 threshold.
